p.d: Музыкальные клипы в эфире телеканала. Новые хиты и временем проверенная "классика" от лучших исполнителей.

Проект "Вокруг света. Места силы" создан для тех, кто устал от банальных справочников и привычных маршрутов, кого не обманешь дешевой "туристической ловушкой", для тех, кому важна правда и только правда. Ведущий "Охотников за привидениями" отправляется в экспедицию по планете в поисках неизведанного. Теперь его цель - воспетые в легендах места, где с человеком происходят подлинные чудеса, а иногда - и просто "странные вещи". Денис бросает вызов не только силам природы и человеческим мифам, но и самому себе. Он не турист в шлепанцах и солнечных очках, а настоящий охотник за необычными ощущениями. Ханой и Далат, дельта Меконга и Ангкор, Бали и остров Ява, Святая Земля и Синай, Каппадокия... В каждом новом месте силы Денис Гребенюк на собственной шкуре испытает сакральную мощь этой точки на карте мира, и расскажет, какие из окружающих её легенд правдивы, а какие - всего лишь приманка для легковерных туристов...

Известный астролог Кали Шанкар поможет героиням найти предназначение, а команда стилистов займется их преображением. Вместе с ТВ-3 они проживут день согласно своему предназначению и решат, следовать ему или нет.

Михаил Стогниенко вместе со зрителями отправится исследовать Россию такой, какой она бывает далеко за пределами МКАДа. Каждый выпуск станет экспедицией в один из городов, куда вместе с Михаилом отправится иностранный шеф-повар высокой кухни Пьер Карбонара. Они вместе привезут с собой главное гастрономическое сокровище ресторана Пьера — эффектное и дорогое блюдо, за которое в столице отдают тысячи рублей. Сумеют ли жители регионов, привыкшие к сытной кухне, оценить гастрономический изыск? Их первая реакция, честная и без скидок, многое расставит по местам.

Баба Нина – уникальная ведунья, которая уединённо живёт в глуши, но к которой обращаются десятки людей. Эта слепая женщина обладает уникальным даром провидения и может рассказать многое о человеке и его судьбе.

Абсолютно новый проект на ТВ-3! Он живет уединенно в лесу, вдали от городской суеты и волнений. Но его деревянный дом, полный света и тепла, становится маяком для всякого, кто потерял надежду и заблудился в лабиринте жизни. Ведь он тот, кто видит судьбу...

Vienkāršs gājiens uz banku, lai izņemtu skaidru naudu, Tripam beidzas ar nokļūšanu gūstā pie divām bankas aplaupītāju bandām vienlaikus. Viņam nākas veikt viltīgus un drosmīgus trikus, lai atbrīvotu ķīlniekus un iekarotu klusībā mīlētās bankas darbinieces sirdi. Taču nekas nav tā, kā tas sākumā izskatās, un pārsteigumi seko viens otram.

Drošības inspektore Ebija reaģē uz brīdinājumu, ka kodolatkritumu glabātuvē fiksēts bojājums. Viņa ierodas nomaļajā spēkstacijā, lai atjaunotu bojāto komunikāciju darbību, taču objekta uzrauga Robinsona nervozā uzvedība Ebijā rada aizdomas. Izmeklējot notikušo, Ebija atklāj bīstamu patiesību par spēkstacijas darbību un korporācijas ļaunprātībām.

"Galvas un astes" - iecienītākais ceļojumu šovs dažādu seju, dzimumu un vecumu ceļotājiem. Viena pilsēta un divi vadītāji. Bet vienam no viņiem ir simts dolāru, kas paredzēti visām izklaidēm, bet otram ir zelta bankas karte. Tas ir monētas metiens. Jūs esat miljonārs vai nabags. Jūs dzīvojat greznā dzīvoklī vai guļat hostelī. Jūs pusdienojat augstas klases restorānā vai paēdat pieticīgā ātrās ēdināšanas ēstuvē. Taču zelta karte nenozīmē neaizmirstamas brīvdienas. Dažkārt pietiek pat ar simts dolāriem, lai ceļojums būtu neaizmirstams uz visiem laikiem.

Zviedru ekstrēmo sacensību čempions un komandas kapteinis Mikaels Lindnords (Marks Valbergs) ar savu komandu šķērso Ekvadoras džungļus. Sacīkšu trase stiepjas 400 jūdžu garumā, un to paredzēts veikt divu nedēļu laikā. Ceļā viņš sastop ievainotu klaiņojošu suni, kuru nosauc par Karali Artūru, un nolemj to neatstāt likteņa varā. No šī brīža suns kļūst par pilntiesīgu komandas biedru - kopā viņi šķērso upes, neskartu savvaļu, pārcieš slimības un traumas. Spītējot visiem pārbaudījumiem, Mikaels pieņem lēmumu ne tikai aizvest Arturu līdz sacensību finišam, bet arī uz mājām.

Emīlija atrod mazu, sarkanu kucēnu un nosauc to par Klifordu. Meitenei pat sapņos nerādās, cik liels viņš pēkšņi izaugs. Kamēr mamma ir prom komandējumā, Emīliju pieskata viņas smieklīgais tēvocis Keisijs. Kucēns vienā mirklī ir kļuvis par lielu mazajam Ņujorkas dzīvoklim, un par viņu uzzina uzņēmums, kurš nodarbojas ar ģenētiskiem eksperimentiem. Lai nosargātu sunīti, viņus un Ņujorku gaida milzīgs piedzīvojums, kura centrā būs lielais, sarkanais suns Klifords!

p.d: Džesika ir nolaupīta un ieslodzīta bēniņos. Vienīgā sievietes cerība ir vecs, salauzts telefons, un viņai pa nejauši izvēlētu numuru izdodas sazvanīt nepazīstamu vīrieti vārdā Raiens. Džesikai izdodas pārliecināt Raienu palīdzēt viņai, taču saruna nevar turpināties bezgalīgi. Gūsteknei nav ne jausmas, kur viņa atrodas, briesmās ir arī viņas ģimene, un laika paliek arvien mazāk…

"Pasaki to skaļi" 5. sezonā vadītāja krēslu līdzās Elīnai Fīrmanei uz laiku ieņems TV personība Roberto Meloni. Roberto ir ļoti iepriecināts un gandarīts, ka var vadīt, viņaprāt, sirsnīgāko un emocionālāko TV raidījumu ar tik lielu virsvērtību kā pateicība! Arī šajā sezonā satiksim interesantus cilvēkus, lai uzklausītu viņu stāstus un paldies vārdus kādiem īpašiem cilvēkiem, dzīves skolotājiem vai vecākiem un, cerams, tie iedvesmo arī mūsu skatītājus teikt vairāk pateicības vārdus skaļi.

Panda vārdā Po, pazīstams arī kā Pūķa Cīnītājs, ir slavens ar īpašajām cīņas mākslas prasmēm, ar ko viņš uzveicis pasaules līmeņa ļaundarus. Po piedzīvojumi turpinās - viņš trenējas, aizsargā, cīnās, māca, apmāca, reizēm klūp, bieži vien pārāk daudz runā un arī izklaidējas. Po tagad dzīvo Miera ielejā, kazarmās kopā ar saviem uzticamajiem draugiem Nikno piecinieku, un piedzīvojumu viņiem netrūkst!

Mums ir iespēja ieskatīties, kā tiek vadīts viens no pasaulē slavenākajiem zoodārziem. 240 dedzīgi kopēji un veterinārārsti rūpējas par vairāk nekā 5000 dzīvniekiem parkā.

Pirmajā raidījuma nedēļā savu mājokļu durvis skatītājiem un pārējiem dalībniekiem vērs aktrise Linda Kalniņa, dziedātāja un sevis pa laikam par multimākslinieci dēvētā Nansija Garkalne, kā arī aktieris Rihards Lepers, kurš, starp citu, sevi nekā citādi nedēvē. Savukārt ceturtais šīs kompānijas dalībnieks brīvdomātājs un mūziķis Horens Stalbe viesus uzņems visai ekstravaganti, sagaidot viņus... halātā! Taču ar to Horena pārsteigumi nebeigsies. Tā vietā, lai aicinātu slavenības uz savām mājām, viņš nolēmis vakariņas rīkot viesnīcā. Tas, protams, raisīs jautājumus pārējo dalībnieku vidū - vai Horenu tiešām izmeta no mājām vai varbūt viesnīca ir viņa paša miera templis? Arī vakariņu ēdienkartē netrūks pārsteigumu, tiesa, ne visi būs patīkami - izrādīsies, ka Nansija Garkalne nebūt nav zivju ēdienu cienītāja.

Jaunajā sezonā Dr. Sirmais tiksies ar viesiem, kas vienreiz jau bijuši vizītē pie daktera, satiekoties vēlreiz ar kādu slavenību no iepriekšējām sezonām uz "otro vizīti". Tikšanās laikā abi draudzīgi pārrunās iemācīto, vērtēs iepriekšējo padomu noderīgumu un pārbaudīs, vai viesu kulinārijas prasmes ir uzlabojušās. Otrajā vizītē Mārtiņš sagaidīs savus pacientus ar brīvdienu ēdienkarti, dodot praktiskus padomus un dažādus knifus brokastu, pusdienu un vakariņu ēdienkartēm, kas noderēs ne vien slavenībām, bet arī skatītājiem. Sirmais turpinās iedvesmot ar jauniem padomiem produktu izvēlē un gardu maltīšu gatavošanā, stāstot, kā to darīt lētāk un gudrāk!

Lara Krofta ir jauna sieviete ar nepakļāvīgu raksturu, kuras tēvs, ekscentrisks piedzīvojumu meklētājs, pirms septiņiem gadiem pazuda bez pēdām. Lai gan Lara ar grūtībām spēj savilkt kopā galus, viņa atsakās pārņemt tēva biznesa impēriju un tikpat spītīgi atsakās pieņemt domu, ka viņas tēvs varētu būt miris. Cerībā atrast kādu pavedienu, Lara dodas briesmu pilnā ceļojumā uz kādu nomaļu salu, kur viņas tēvs manīts pēdējo reizi. Viņas vienīgie ieroči ir asais prāts, aklā ticība un stūrgalvība.

Leģendārie spoku mednieki nekur nav pazuduši! Nonākusi finansiālās grūtībās un neredzot vairs citu iespēju, vientuļā māte Kellija ar savām divām pusaugu atvasēm Fēbi un Trevoru pārvācas uz nomaļu pilsētiņu Samervilu, kur viņa var apmesties sava ekscentriskā nelaiķa tēva pussabrukušajā mājā. Tomēr ātri vien kļūst skaidrs, ka ar šo māju notiek kas savāds – vectēvs viņiem atstājis neparastu mantojumu un ģimenei nāksies sastapties ar slavenajiem spoku medniekiem.

Herijs un Loids ir labākie draugi ar vienu nelielu problēmu - viņi nav īpaši gudri. Toties viņiem ir laba sirds. Pamanījuši, ka skaista sieviete aizmirst lidostā savu koferi, viņi nedomājot iesaistās, lai to atgrieztu īpašniecei. Abi bezsmadzeņu neveiksminieki seko sievietei, pat nenojaušot, ka koferis ir pilns ar naudu. Ceļojums izvēršas garš, kurā ķibele seko ķibelei, un draugi nonāk sniegainajā Espenā, Kolorādo štatā, kur cenšas atrast sievieti. Vai viņiem izdosies?

Pirmo reizi visas spraiga sižeta filmu megazvaigznes vienā grāvējā! Bārnijs Rossas ir vīrs, kuram nav, ko zaudēt. Tieši viņš vada četru nīgru un profesionālu vīru bandu, kas apņemas paveikt citiem neiespējamo. Viņi dodas uz Dienvidameriku, lai gāztu kādas mazas valsts nežēlīgo diktatoru. Sākumā šķietami labu peļņu nesošais darbs izvēršas par skarbāko pieredzi dzīvē - nākas piedzīvot nodevību, pārvērtēt draudzību un censties… izdzīvot.

Maša un Maksims atkal dodas prom - šoreiz uz Nīderlendi, atstājot nu jau septiņus gadus veco Žeņu Mašas vecāku - priecīgo lauku ļaužu - uzraudzībā. Tomēr nepaiet ne diena, kad ciemā ierodas arī smalkie un vīzdegunīgie Maksima vecāki - viņi vēlas mīļoto mazmeitiņu sagatavot skolai, kā arī nedomā pieļaut, ka Mašas vecāki saņems Žeņas nedalītu uzmanību. Žeņa ir jau pietiekoši liela, lai saprastu - šīs vasaras galvenais uzdevums būs uzturēt mieru mājās. Vai mazai meitenei izdosies šķietami neiespējamais - samierināt nesamierināmos?

Nepālas ceļojums var sākties! Jau pirmajā sērijā dosimies uz visnotaļ bīstamu savvaļas vietu - Nepālas džungļiem, kur pārsteigumi gaida ik uz soļa! Raidījumā uzzināsiet, kā izvērtīsies saldās medus medības pie milzu asinskārajām bitēm un kā ar masveidīgu rituālu palīdzību iespējams apturēt sausumu, kā arī dosimies uz grandiozām svinībām Himalajos. Bet Dmitrijs Komarovs būs liecinieks nežēlīgam rituālam, kas šokēs līdz sirds dziļumiem. Kāpēc cilvēki joprojām upurē dievus, lūdzot viņiem aizsardzību un palīdzību? To uzzini piedzīvojumiem bagātajā un ekstrēmajā Nepālas ceļojumā!

Andrejs Kravecs ir godprātīgs un principiāls operatīvais darbinieks. Tieši viņa godprātība noved pie saķeršanās ar augsti stāvošu un ietekmīgu politiķi, kurš saniknojas ne pa jokam. Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. Un šī komanda noliks pie vietas ne vienu vien Odesas noziedznieku!

Lai pasargātu Andreju no neparedzamām sekām, vadība pārceļ viņu no galvaspilsētas uz dzimto Odesu. Dzimtajā pilsētā Andreju jau sagaida seni draugi – bijušais bokseris Fedja, kurš nerunā daudz, bet ir uzticams līdz kaulam, un Makss – talantīgs inženieris un programmētājs. The Virgin Queen explores the full sweep of Elizabeth's life: from her days of fear as a potential victim of her sister's terror; through her great love affair with Robert Dudley; into her years of triumph over the Armada; and finally her old age and her last, enigmatic relationship with her young protégé, the Earl of Essex.

Lucy Freers has a long-standing marriage, a nine-year old daughter, and a great family life in the suburbs of Hollywood. Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

p.d: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When a ruthless arms dealer stages a prison escape, Jane Doe and NSA chief Frank Darnell quickly realise that a plot for deadly revenge lies behind it.

Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

p.t: Jane Doe: Yes, I Remember It Well
p.d: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

Wildlife biologist and animal tracker, Forrest Galante, sets out on the Indian Ocean to search for the Pondicherry shark-believed to be extinct since the 1970s. The rare species' alleged extinction has been recently questions, due to recent photos appearing of unidentified sharks around Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Could the Pondicherry shark still be alive? If Galante can prove it's still alive, it will be removed off the extinct species list. Extinct or Alive.

This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

Documentary series following six students at the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine, as they prepare to complete their gruelling four-year education at one of the most prestigious veterinarian colleges in the world. Known as Penn Vet, the institute is recognised as one of the most distinguished schools in animal research and care, and the course requires the students' full devotion if they wish to graduate as veterinarians. Watch the students as they meander their perpetual studies and put their learning into practice, growing both as people and professionals during the intense, consuming course.

When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

Спецслужбы проводят взрывные работы на участке, где зафиксированы магнитные аномалии. Совершенно случайно в зоне взрыва оказываются три человека: преступник Владимир Голенко, фотохудожник Олег Малинин и неудачливый писатель Венедикт Тартаковский. В результате взрыва между этими людьми возникает странная связь – фотограф Малинин может читать мысли преступника Голенко, и даже видеть окружающий мир его глазами, а писатель Тартаковский может полностью управлять действиями Голенко и при этом общаться с Малининым на расстоянии. Тартаковский, получив в свое полное распоряжение преступника Голенко, решает его руками отомстить всем, кто мешал ему в жизни. Город захлестывает череда кровавых преступлений...

Голенко убивает Катю. Малинин в отчаянии. Бражник не верит в видения Малинина и считает его сообщником убийцы, тем более, что в квартире Кати найдены его отпечатки пальцев. Малинина объявляют в розыск. Он скрывается на даче Кати. Тартаковский тем временем задумывает новое убийство - на этот раз, жертва - Татьяна, девушка, которая его отвергла. Малинин снова это "видит". Он пытается самостоятельно найти Голенко, через Васильченко, адрес которого он "подсмотрел", когда Голенко с ним встречался. Но Васильченко подозревает в Малинине полицейского. Он бьет его по голове, приковывает наручниками к батарее и сбегает. Голенко, который в этот момент, уже готов убить Татьяну, неожиданно теряет сознание. Тартаковский озабочен, что произошло с его марионеткой? Малинин удается выбраться из квартиры Васильченко. Он приходит к Николаевой и все ей рассказывает.

Сериал рассказывает о работе специального подразделения полиции, занимающегося проблемами домашнего насилия. Четыре главные героини помогают женщинам, детям и даже мужчинам, страдающим от тирании, побоев, унижений и других способов угнетения со стороны близких людей. Героини сериала будут попадать в сложные и опасные ситуации, спасая жизни и восстанавливая справедливость. Каждая женщина из этой четверки тоже прошла через насилие: у каждой – своя история, скелет в шкафу и сильная мотивация заниматься именно этим делом.

Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. Two complete strangers -- a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food and water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the two as they attempt to survive on their own for 21 days, with nothing but one personal item each and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, the couple quickly get to know each other -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude will serve them well.

Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

The deep sea is fascinating, hazardous and the last unexplored frontier left on the planet and it contains many unsolved mysteries which have baffled experts throughout history. One of the vehicles that Ant has a particular obsession with is the 1930s Alfa Romeo 158 Grand Prix race car, one of the greatest racers ever made, which he is honouring in this documentary series by building his own from scratch. We follow Ant and his Alfa on their journey from workshop to race circuit, as he overcomes challenges, setbacks and deadlines to get this commemorative racer ready in time.

A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia - the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature - the weedy sea dragon - a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin - the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world - the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters - albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!
Nakts programma ar mūzikas video dažādām gaumēm. Dejojiet, dziediet līdzi vai izbaudiet, guļot zem segas.

Ar piecu gadu starpību tiek seksuāli izmantotas un nožņaugtas divas jaunas sievietes. Abas lietas vieno viens un tas pats nezināmais DNS. Kad abu gadījumu izmeklēšana nonāk strupceļā, Ņujorkas pilsētas un štata policijas 17 gadus vēlāk apvieno spēkus, lai atrastu slepkavu.
Braitonbīčā pazūd ukraiņu imigrants. Tiesībaizsardzības iestāžu labāko aģentu komanda no Ņujorkas policijas, ASV prokurora biroja un FIB sadarbojas, lai noskaidrotu notikušo.

14 gadus vecā Kristija Mulinsa noslepkavota Klintonvillā Ohaio. Slepkavība paliek neatrisināta 40 gadus, kamēr jauna sieviete norāda, ka slepkava ir meitenes onkulis. Izrādās, viņam patiesi ir pārsteidzoša saikne ar upuri.

Čārlijs Kinkels pazudis nomaļā Nevadas raktuvju pilsētā. Viņa sieva Treisa veic izmeklēšanu, bet atduras pret vietējiem iedzīvotājiem. Pēc ķermeņa atklāšanas policija norāda, ka Čārlija slepkavība bijusi traģiska sakritība.

Patrīciju Millu nonāvē mājas ugunsgrēks Teksasā. Viņas māsa uzstāj, ka ugunsgrēks nebija nejaušība. Paiet 10 gadi, līdz atklājas šaušalīgākais - ugunsgrēks patiesi nav bijis nejaušs, un Patrīcija tikusi noslepkavota.
Elenas aizsegs tiek apdraudēts, kad Greibornā negaidīti parādās kāds no viņas pagātnes.
Sezonas noslgumā tiek pārbaudītas esošās alianses un veidotas jaunas. Greiborna nekad vairs nebūs tāda pati - beidzot parādīsies patiesības vilnis.

Kad nezināms akciju brīnumbērns Martins Škreli mākslīgi uzpūš lētas AIDS zāles cenu, viņš ātri vien kļūst par Amerikas visienīstāko cilvēku. Tā vietā, lai bēgtu, viņš uzsāk dīvainu vārdu karu ar hiphopa leģendām Wu Tang Clan par īpašumtiesībām uz vairāku miljonu dolāru vērto slepeno albumu.

Stāsts par NBA zvaigzni Baisonu Dele, agrāk Braienu Viljamsu, kuram bija viss, taču viņš pievērsās nomadu dzīvei zem zvaigznēm, pirms noslēpumaini pazuda uz laivas Klusā okeāna dienvidu daļā. Policija atmasko Viljamsa dzīves līkločus, atklāj liktenīgu naudas un greizsirdības sajaukumu, kas rezultējās problēmās ģimenē.
Noslēpums par bitkoinu miljonāru Džeraldu Kotonu, kurš nomira aizdomīgos apstākļos, kad 2019. gadā no viņa kriptovalūtu biržas pēkšņi pazuda simtiem miljonu dolāru.
Astoņus gadus veca meitene atklāj, ka viņas māte pēc maiņas Lasvegasas kazino mājās ir nežēlīgi piekauta līdz nāvei. Policija izmanto novērošanas kameru ierakstus, cerot atklāt slepkavas.
Slepkava 193 reizes sadur savu uzticīgo tēvu Džefu Raitu un apglabā viņu viņa paša mājas pagalmā. Izmeklētāji pārbauda viņa pagātni, cenšoties atrast vainīgo.

Pirmās 48 stundas pēc nozieguma izdarīšanas izmeklētāju darbā ir visbūtiskākās, jo tieši šis laikposms nereti izšķir to, vai noziegums tiks atšķetināts. Vēlāk izmeklētāju izredzes notvert vainīgo sarūk uz pusi. Raidījums ļauj ielūkoties ASV slepkavību izmeklētāju ikdienā, kuri neatlaidīgi strādā, lai jau pirmajās nozieguma izdarīšanas stundās atklātu pēc iespējas vairāk detaļu par ļaunprātības apstākļiem. Skatītājus sagaida reāls izmeklēšanas process, liecinieku intervijas, kriminālistiskās ekspertīzes aizkulises un iespēja ielūkoties vietās, kur nupat pastrādāts noziegums.

Savdabīgs randiņu šovs, kurā cilvēki līdz ar mīlas peripetijām iepazīstas ar pakāpeniski atkalinātiem ķermeņiem. Pēcāk jāizģērbjas arī viņiem pašiem un jāizvēlas.
Savdabīgs randiņu šovs, kurā cilvēki līdz ar mīlas peripetijām iepazīstas ar pakāpeniski atkalinātiem ķermeņiem. Pēcāk jāizģērbjas arī viņiem pašiem un jāizvēlas.
Pēc veselības problēmām dakteris Metam nozīmē stingru mieru; tas kļūst īpaši grūti, kad tiek pasludināts Odžeja Simpsona spriedums, un ģimene dara visu, lai viņš neuzzinātu patiesību.

Džūlsa Vailija pēdējos piecus gadus ir pilnībā iegrimusi savās attiecībās. Kad draugs viņu negaidīti pamet, Džūlsa saprot, ka viņas draudzība ar citām sievietēm ir sairusi, un viņa nolemj rīkot meiteņu vakaru, lai mēģinātu to labot.
Džūlsa vēršas pie draudzenēm pēc padoma par izvākšanos no bijušā partnera mājām, taču ātri vien saprot, ka izvēlēties, kuras draudzenes ieteikumam sekot, ir vēl sarežģītāk.
Džūlsa cenšas izprast nerakstītos likumus par noslēpumu glabāšanu draudzeņu lokā, kas rada problēmas Medisonei darbā. Savukārt Stella mēģina iemācīt Izijai būt noslēpumainākai.

Draudzenes mēģina tikt skaidrībā ar saviem personīgajiem "brendiem". Džūlsa un Stella uzņemas "garlaicīgās" un "jautrās" lomas. Medisone, "valdonīgā", palīdz Izijai, "trakajai", atbrīvoties no uzspēlētās identitātes.
Danfiju māja ir pilna, kad Dilana hippiju mamma ievācas pie viņiem, un Klēras vientuļais patēvs Džerijs vēlas viņus apciemot; Džejs un Glorija palīdz Menijam pārvarēt smago šķiršanos ar Šeriju.

Mičam ir aizdomas, ka Kems slēpj savus patiesos motīvus, cenšoties visus iepriecināt Ziemassvētku vakariņās; Klēra mēģina izvairīties no Džeja darba piedāvājuma viņa suņu gultu uzņēmumā; Lūks risina sekas pēc skūpsta ar Menija bijušajo draudzeni.

Aleksas uzņēmums nodrošina viņai jaunu luksusa dzīvokli ēkā ar vairākiem ievērojamiem iedzīvotājiem, kurus ģimene cenšas izmantot savā labā; Fils dodas novērtēt restorāna slavenos burgerus savam ēdiena blogam.
Fils apciemo tēvu, jo dzirdējis satraucošas ziņas; Džejs dod Klērai un Mičam vairākas bērnības piemiņas lietas, kas liek viņiem pārvērtēt senu stāstu par pirmajām ģimenes brīvdienām.

Mičs gūst vērtīgu mācību, kad ieradas kāds bijušais mājas iemītnieks; Danfiju vecais kaimiņš Kenets kļuvis par tehnoloģiju magnātu, viņš ierodas ar lielu pārsteigumu Filam; Menija tēvs piedāvā savam dēlam lielu iespēju.

Kad Pegija atklāj, ka neviens nezina Sevena dzimšanas dienas datumu, viņa ar nejaušības principu izvēlas vienu - to pašu, kas Alam. Saprotams, viņš nav apmierināts, zaudējot savus svētkus jaunam bērnam. Pegija vietējā parkā nolemj sarīkot nelielu ballīti Sevena sestajā dzimšanas dienā. Ballīte izbeidzas nesākusies, jo ierodas kāds snobisks bagāts vecāks un pasludina parku par privātu - sava bērna ballītes vajadzībām.

Pegija iztērē ikmēneša hipotēkai atlikto naudu, lai apmaksātu Sevena medicīnas izdevumus. Als ir spiests uzņemties otru darbu, strādājot bārā. Tiesa - tas ir vīriešu striptīzklubs, kurā bārmenis un visi pārējie vīrieši staigā atkailinātu augšu. Alam patīk savs darbs, bet, kad Džefersons vienu dienu aizvieto Alu, viņš pārņem viņa amatu. Tikmēr Pegija sāk aizliegt Kellijai un Badam ierasties mājā, sargājot Sevenu no viņu mikrobiem.

p.d: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Красавица Аля – мать-одиночка, работает баристой и воспитывает 5-ти летнего сына. Бывший парень бросил ее одну с ребенком. Девушка долго никого не подпускала к себе, пока не встретила мажора Гошу. И впервые за долгое время подумала, что он ― тот мужчина, с которым можно шагать по жизни легко и просто. Но Гоша бросает девушку. В это время Аля встречает друга Гоши Костю, который предлагает ей сделку: сыграть роль его несносной, бесцеремонной невесты, чтобы семья перестала думать о женитьбе Кости. Но все идет не по плану….

The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

In Ronny Yu's fast-moving crime-thriller, Samuel L Jackson plays Elmo McElroy, a pharmaceutical genius who has made a fortune in illegal drugs, particularly with Formula 51, which is more potent than heroin and crack. But instead of selling it to his drug lord employer the Lizard (Meatloaf), he flies to Liverpool where Felix (Robert Carlyle) is acting as broker for gangster Leopold Durant (Ricky Tomlinson). Durant is prepared to offer $20m for the formula; money Elmo would love to spend, if he can stay alive long enough.

In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

"Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.
A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

p.t: I Could Never Be Your Woman
p.d: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.
The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

p.t: That Trip We Took with Dad
p.d: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

Unlucky in love, living at home with her eccentric mom, and stuck in a dead end secretarial job at Judge Pharmaceuticals, Sarah Jane longs for more out of life. Her surprise promotion to junior executive appears to be just the ticket. But with promotion comes a competitive new world of wily, complicated executives, and Sarah Jane begins to eliminate the competition the only way she knows how - murder. During her climb to the top, she unexpectedly falls for the man of her dreams, Detective Bill Malloy - the cop intent on cracking the case of the mysterious deaths at Judge Pharmaceuticals.

Ir divdesmito gadu beigas. Britu jauneklis no turīgas ģimenes Džons Vitekers pēc īsas un kaislīgas pazīšanās Francijā apprecas ar šarmantu amerikānieti Laritu Hantingtoni. Kad jaunais pāris ierodas Džona vecāku mājās Anglijā, Larita sastopas ar vēsu un aizdomīgu vīramātes attieksmi. Atturīgajiem britiem jaunās sievietes uzvedība šķiet pārāk izaicinoša. Drīz sākas abu sieviešu cīņa - Vitekera kundze cenšas cik spēdama izēst vedeklu, taču sastopas ar asprātīgu svešinieces pretreakciju.

Pēc pāvesta negaidītās nāves katoļu kardinālu kolēģija sapulcējas Vatikānā uz vēlēšanām, lai izvēlētos jauno pāvestu un iezīmētu jauno baznīcas laikmetu. Aiz Siksta kapelas slēgtajām durvīm kardināli no visas pasaules sacenšas par šo godu rūpīgi sargātā rituālā, kas sakņojas gadsimtiem tālā pagātnē.

Eiženija ir meistarīga pavāre, kura jau vairāk nekā 20 gadus strādā pie izsmalcināta gardēža Dodēna. Laika gaitā viņu sadarbība pāraugusi romantiskās attiecībās, kas iedvesmo gardus ēdienus, par kuriem sajūsminās pat pasaules izcilākie šefpavāri. Tomēr, neraugoties uz Dodēna uzstājību, Eiženija nesteidzas teikt viņam jāvārdu. Lai mīļoto pārliecinātu, Dodēns nolemj sākt gatavot maltītes viņai.
1918. gada Spāņu gripas laikā nerātns pavārs vada sacelšanos pret savu bagāto darba devēju.
Kad jautājums ir būt vai nebūt, ir tikai viena atbilde!

Drīz vien četrotne tiek iesaistīta galma intrigās un bīstamos piedzīvojumos.

Koledžas amerikāņu futbola komandas ūdenspuika atklāj sevī unikālu spēju efektīvi apturēt pretiniekus un kļūst par komandas spēlētāju.

Filma "127 stundas" balstīta uz patiesiem notikumiem par alpīnistu Āronu Ralstonu, kuru filmā spēlē aktieris Džeimss Franko. Stāsts risinās pēc negadījuma Jūtas štata kanjonos, kad Āronu klinšu aizā iesprosto klintsbluķis, piespiežot viņa roku pret akmens sienu. Turpmākās piecas dienas jeb 127 stundas alpīnists cīnās par dzīvību un ir spiests pieņemt izmisīgu, taču drosmīgu lēmumu, nozāģējot savu roku, kas ir viņa vienīgā iespēja palikt dzīvam.

Lai glābtu mīļoto, musketieris ir spiests apvienot spēkus ar bezbailīgo un nežēlīgo Milēdiju. Taču karalisti sašķēluši reliģiskie kari un sācies Anglijas iebrukums. Atoss, Portoss un Aramiss jau ir pievienojušies frontei, un kāds sens noslēpums sagrauj vecās alianses.

p.t: Trīs paziņojumi pie Ebingas Misūri štatā
p.d: Mildredas Heizas meita Andžela tika izvarota un noslepkavota pirms vairāk nekā pusgada, taču slepkavības izmeklēšana nevirzās uz priekšu. Mildreda sper izmisīgu un pārdrošu soli - uz ceļa, kura malā Andžela tika atrasta, viņa uz reklāmas stendiem izvieto trīs paziņojumus, kas adresēti Ebingas pilsētiņas šerifam Viljamam Vilobijam. Policija uzskata šo par kara pieteikumu un dara visu, lai paziņojumi tiktu aizvākti. Taču Mildreda nedomā padoties, un spriedze tikai pieaug.

Bijušo meksikāņu "federale"" ar segvārdu Mačete nodod viņa darba devējs un vēlas viņu nogalināt... Tomēr neticamā veidā Mačete izglābjas. Ar sava drauga, priestera Benito del Toro palīdzību, kurš drauga dēļ ir gatavs atsacīties no nenogalināšanas zvēresta, Mačete dodas asiņainā atriebes ceļojumā. Tajā viņš nežēlo nevienu, kurš stājas viņam pretī. Un, protams, pa ceļam Mačete pagūst apliecināt savu brunču mednieka statusu.

After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

Every region has its own local culture and flavor. One of the best ways for a traveler to immerse him or herself in new destinations is to taste these unique dishes. This taste exploration allows even the strictest of dieters the freedom to indulge. In the new series, Travel Channel's Man v. Food, host Adam Richman sets out to travel the country in search of the best places to do some serious indulging. Starting season 5, Casey Webb took over as host.

Through powerful real-life stories, this documentary series explores the universal nature of love and human connection. Each episode follows individuals facing personal challenges, meaningful relationships, and life-changing experiences, revealing the strength found in compassion and understanding. Combining intimate storytelling with emotional depth, the series celebrates resilience, hope, and the enduring capacity of people to care for one another despite adversity.

Viewers follow the transformation of homes, renovation projects, and community initiatives in an engaging and informative way. Each episode highlights practical solutions, creative design ideas, and real-life stories, offering inspiration for personal living spaces. The program combines entertainment with useful insights, helping audiences discover innovative ways to enhance comfort, style, and functionality at home.

A documentary series dedicated to debunking the most influential myths of Russian propaganda. The project goes beyond the analysis of ordinary " fake news " to explore the deep historical manipulations that Russia uses as a tool of external aggression and justification of imperial ambitions.

Kritiķu cildināta tumšā komēdija par topošu aktieri, kurš, lai pārveidotu savu izskatu, veic radikālu medicīnisku procedūru, bet jaunā seja ātri pārvērš viņa dzīvi murgā.

Sava nežēlīgā vīra ietekmē Bella (Emma Stouna) ir izdarījusi pašnāvību, taču ekscentrisks zinātnieks (Vilems Defo) nolemj izglābt sievieti un pārstāda viņai pašas vēl nedzimušā bērna smadzenes. Viņa aizbildniecībā Bella alkst mācīties un iepazīt dzīvi, kas Viktorijas laikmeta stingrajā sabiedrībā viņai līdz šim bijusi liegta. Kopā ar viltīgo un valdzinoši cinisko juristu Dankanu Vederbērnu viņa dodas ceļojumā pāri kontinentiem. Ceļojuma laikā Bella arvien vairāk atbrīvojas no sava laikmeta aizspriedumiem un sabiedrības ierobežojumiem.

Kad viņa teātrim draud slēgšana, uzņēmējdarbībā pieredzējušais koala Basters Mūns (Metjū Makkonahijs) sarīko dziesmu konkursu. Daudziem vietējiem zvēriem tas rada iespēju izpausties. Cūka Rosita (Rīza Viterspūna) ir māte un mājsaimniece, kura atteicās no pusaudža sapņa kļūt par dziedātāju. Pusaudze dzeloņcūka Eša (Skārleta Johansone) ir pancīga roķere alternatīvās mūzikas grupā. Gorillu Džoniju (Tārons Edžertons) viņa tēvs (Pīters Serafinovičs) grib pārliecināt pievērsties savam banku aplaupītāja arodam. Ikkatrs no šiem radījumiem vēlas piepildīt savu sapni un dziedāt no visas sirds!

p.t: Rūfuss: jūras briesmonis, kas nemācēja peldēt
p.d: Rufuss īsti neiederas – savā jūras čūsku kopienā viņš ir vienīgais, kurš neprot peldēt. Kad notiek nelaime un viņu slepenā sala ir jāaizsargā, Rufusam jāsastopas ar savām lielākajām bailēm un jāizglābj ģimene.

Pēc tam, kad futbola spēlē mazais Stjuarts par mata tiesu izvairās no nopietnas traumas, viņa audžumāmiņa sāk pārmērīgi uztraukties par pelēna drošību. Lielais brālis Džordžs savukārt ir atradis sev jaunu draugu un atstājis Stjuartu novārtā. Kad drosmīgais pelēns izglābj no vanaga nagiem kanārijputniņu Margalo, viņa sāk dzīvot kopā ar Litlu ģimeni. Taču kādu dienu Stjuarta jaunā draudzene vairs nekur nav atrodama. Stjuarts un viņa kādreizējais ļaunākais ienaidnieks kaķis Sniegapika apvienojas, lai atrastu Margolo. Savukārt Džordžs pirmo reizi mūžā ir spiests piesegt mazā brālīša prombūtni un melot māmiņai.

Laipni lūgti viesnīcā "Transilvānija", Drakulas krāšņajā pieczobu kūrortā, kurā monstri var izbaudīt nesteidzīgu atpūtu. Ir pienākusi īpaša nedēļas nogale, kuras laikā Drakula ir ielūdzis ciemos dažus no saviem labākajiem draugiem. Ir plānots svinēt Drakulas meitas Meivisas pilngadību – 118. dzimšanas dienu. Uzņemt tik kuplu viesu pulku Drakulas ģimenei nav problēma. Tomēr jukas izceļas, kad viesnīcā ieklīst parasts puisis un ieskatās viņa meitā.

Savā grāmatā piedzīvojumu kārais Haralds var atdzīvināt jebko, to vienkārši uzzīmējot. Pieaugot un attālinoties no grāmatas lappusēm un nonākot reālajā pasaulē, Haralds saprot, ka viņam ir daudz jāmācās par īsto dzīvi.

Četri vidusskolēni atrod vecu spēļu konsoli ar līdz šim neredzētu videospēli džumandži. Viņi iesaistās šajā spēlē, kas norisinās džungļos, un iemiesojas pašu izraudzītajos avataros. Jaunieši apjauš, ka džumandži ir kas vairāk par spēli, tā ir cīņa par izdzīvošanu. Lai uzvarētu spēlē, viņiem jādodas bīstamākajā piedzīvojumā mūžā, jāatklāj Alana Periša pirms 20 gadiem atstātās pēdas un jāmaina priekšstats pašiem par sevi, pretējā gadījumā viņi paliks ieslēgti spēlē uz visiem laikiem...

Spengleru ģimene atgriežas vietā, kur viss sākās – ikoniskajā Ņujorkas ugunsdzēsēju depo –, lai apvienotos ar sākotnējiem Spoku medniekiem, kuri izveidojuši īpaši slepenu izpētes laboratoriju, paceļot spoku medīšanu nākamajā līmenī. Bet, kad sena artefakta atklāšana atbrīvo ļaunu spēku, jaunajiem un vecajiem Spoku medniekiem jākļūst par vienu komandu, lai aizstāvētu savu pilsētu un glābtu pasauli no jauna ledus laikmeta.

Noslēpumainā Čārlza Taunsenda detektīvaģentūra atvērusi birojus visā pasaulē. Tās paspārnē vairāku Bosliju vadībā izveidotas Eņģeļu komandas, kurās darbojas visgudrākās, visdrosmīgākās un visaugstāk kvalificētās sievietes, kam jātiek galā ar vissarežģītākajiem uzdevumiem jebkur uz zemeslodes.

Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!
Ietekmīga sabiedrības dāma un daudzsološs baleta dejotājs uzsāk bīstamu romānu. Kad viņš slepeni šķērso ASV un Meksikas robežu, viņa sper izmisīgus soļus, lai pasargātu viņu kopīgo nākotni.
Kāds vientuļnieks uz attālas Skotijas salas izglābj meiteni no jūras, izraisot bīstamu notikumu virkni, kas kulminējas ar uzbrukumu viņa mājām, liekot viņam saskarties ar savu nemierīgo pagātni.

Koledžas studente Anastasija Stīla savas saslimušās istabas biedrenes vietā dodas intervēt slaveno uzņēmēju Kristianu Greju universitātes avīzei, taču meitene nenojauš, kā mainīsies viņas dzīve. Noslēpumainajam, bagātajam un ietekmīgajam Kristianam iepatīkas Ana. Lai gan meitenes seksuālā pieredze ir visai niecīga, viņa ļaujas šai dēkai un uzzina, ka Kristiana seksuālās tieksmes pārkāpj sāpju un baudas robežas.

Kellijai un Mekam šķiet, ka viņi kopā ar jaundzimušo bērnu ir pārcēlušies uz klusu rajonu, taču tad kaimiņos ievācas studentu korporācijas puiši. Tedijs ir korporācijas prezidents, un Pīts ir viņa vietnieks. Puiši naski pieņem draudzības piedāvājumu, kad Kellija un Meks ierodas iepazīties. Tomēr drīz vien laulātajam pārim ir jāsauc talkā policija jauno kaimiņu savaldīšanai. Šī rīcība izraisa šausminošas sekas.

UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

p.d: Tiny Luxury follows husband and wife tiny home builder duo, Tyson and Michelle Spiess. Together with Michelle's two brothers and their wives they run the country's top high-end tiny home-building company. They make luxurious custom homes that can all hit the highway so their clients can live however they want, wherever they want. In each episode we'll see a tiny home built from start to finish as this team works to fit every single client wish item into a space suited to travel anywhere.

Most people only fantasize about living on an island, but we'll prove that an Island Life is possible for anyone. Tropical dreamers will be shown island properties that fit into any budget, from ultra-affordable to totally outrageous. We'll follow everyday families is search of their own slice of paradise, and prove that fantasy can be reality.

After spending many summers on the island, a couple sets out to make their dream come true and find a forever home on Nantucket. They each have unique memories of growing up there and recognize the importance of passing the same experiences on to their daughters. Will they find the beautiful island home they've been dreaming of?

Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

Attempting to bring families' dreams come to life, but on a budget, Beachfront Bargain Hunt shows that you don't have to be a millionaire if you want to live a life by the sea! Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

American reality series following host Suzanne Whang on her quest to help people relocate in search of their dream home. Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.

Tarek and Christina get a lead on a property in Santa Ana, California that has the potential to be both a great entry level family home and a profitable flip. But after walking it with their contractor, it's clear this run down home is going to need a lot of work. Can Tarek and Christina bring this project in on time and on budget, or could bad luck and big problems threaten to bring the profit crashing down on this dilapidated flip?

After receiving a postcard about a job offer on Washington Island, WI, a MI couple took a trip to visit and fell in love with the friendly community. Now they're searching for a home with plenty of bedrooms for friends and family to visit and extra room to open up a vacation rental.

A young Milwaukee couple moves to secluded Washington Island, Wisconsin, and looks forward to being part of the tight-knit community. They want to find a home with an open layout so they can invite friends over for game night.

Clients seek out Georgia and Richie to revamp their dated mountain home into a moody masterpiece. Inspired by their clients' travels, Georgia and Richie incorporate color and functionality into their new home.

The series will follow Izzy and his family as they work together to develop their home renovation and design business in Santa Ana, California — Izzy's hometown. By the end of each hour-long episode, Izzy will deliver dazzling renovation results to clients with realistic budgets in the area.

For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

Following declassified FBI files that link Hitler's U-boat unloading site to a massive German owned estate in the Southern Andes, the team uncovers the town of Bariloche and the Inalco House, where Hitler could have stayed. After trying to gain access to the property with aerial drones and a secret swim through the water, the team is able to take photos of the mysterious interior as well as finds a vent that could lead to a bunker.

Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

Wondrous wizards... Mysterious sorcerers... And heavenly beings... possessed of unimaginable power. Throughout the ancient world, magic was used for everything from healing to communicating with the gods. But did magic really exist in the ancient times? Not as a form of theater - but as a means of replicating the power of the gods? Do ancient accounts of magic suggest evidence of advanced, otherworldly knowledge? A knowledge given to early humans as a means of helping them unlock their own - some might say "divine" - potential?

From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

p.t: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
p.d: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

Wondrous wizards... Mysterious sorcerers... And heavenly beings... possessed of unimaginable power. Throughout the ancient world, magic was used for everything from healing to communicating with the gods. But did magic really exist in the ancient times? Not as a form of theater - but as a means of replicating the power of the gods? Do ancient accounts of magic suggest evidence of advanced, otherworldly knowledge? A knowledge given to early humans as a means of helping them unlock their own - some might say "divine" - potential?

From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

p.t: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
p.d: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.
